messages:
maria: Heads up — sudden IOPS spike on gpu-pool-3 around 2026-03-17T02:45Z. Multiple GPU pods reported high disk latency and a few evicted. I see ephemeral-cleaner jobs started at the same time.
aj: On it. Can you paste iostat and the cleaner command/logs?
maria: cleaner log snippet: `ephemeral-cleaner[pid=2245]: start cleanup parallel=64 target=/var/lib/ephemeral/ removed=1200` — lots of rm, rm -rf loops.
devon: iostat -x (short):
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  rrqm/s  wrqm/s  r_await  w_await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1         12.0   480.0  512.0  61440.0   0.00    0.00    0.30    180.00  0.90  99.90
(looks like write bursts saturating device, await ~180ms)
devon: kubectl get events on node gpu-3-12: many evictions/FailedKillPod due to NodePressure or processes stuck on IO.
infra-bot: ALERT: node/gpu-3-12 disk_io_saturation > 0.9 (auto-remediation disabled) :warning:
dave: That concurrency=64 is brutal for nvme devices with mixed small deletes. We changed it for throughput but it's starving other pods. Suggest immediate mitigation: reduce concurrency to 8, add a simple rate limiter (ionice + throttle writes) and exponential backoff between directory batches.
dave: example patch to ConfigMap (applied as kubectl patch):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: ephemeral-cleaner-config
data:
  concurrency: "8"
  rate_limit_mb_per_sec: "50"
  backoff_ms: "500"
```
maria: patched configmap and rolled cleaner StatefulSet (kubectl rollout restart).
devon: monitoring update 5m after restart — iostat now: %util down to ~25, w_await ~5ms, overall latency back to normal.
maria: still seeing a couple nodes with nonzero reallocated sector count in smartctl. snippet: `SMART Attributes Data Structure revision number: 1\n  5 Reallocated_Sector_Ct 0x0033 100 100 0 Pre-fail  Always - 1` — small but appeared coincident with the write storm.
aj: reallocated sectors low but we should avoid hammering those drives. We can annotate nodes with wear signals so cleaner avoids them.
dave: Proposed short-term policy: annotate nodes with `ephemeral.avoid=true` when SMART shows >0 reallocated or temperature >70C. Cleaner will skip annotated nodes. Longer-term: add scheduler predicate so pods that trigger heavy deletes land on low-wear nodes.
sre-oncall: I'll open INFRA-4821 to track: add node annotations, cleaner-aware scheduler predicate, and a dashboard for drive wear. For immediate ops: keep concurrency=8 and rate_limit=50MB/s for 48h, monitor.
maria: Confirming GPU pods recovered and no further evictions in the last 10 minutes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
aj: Recording action items in the thread: 1) INFRA-4821 ticket 2) Roll cleaner changes to prod for all pools 3) Dashboard + annotation plan.
devon: We'll also add a small script to the scrub workflow to run `smartctl -A` before heavy deletes and set annotation if thresholds hit.
maria: Nice — closing this thread once INFRA-4821 is created. Current status: mitigated, monitoring.
